To: #announcements
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: Linden Pantry charity stream — Nov 21

@everyone charity stream is happening Saturday Nov 21!! 10am–10pm for Linden Community Pantry.

posting this early because last year half the server didn’t even know until basically the day of 😭 we still raised $212, which was awesome, but this year the goal is $600.

donate here: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry, and rook is matching the first $100 donated, so the first $100 counts double. even $3 helps. and seriously, if you can’t give, no guilt at all.

the pantry is serving around 340 families a week, and Denise said their shelves are really low going into Thanksgiving. through their wholesale partner, $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food.

also before anyone says it: it’s not begging if u get hair dye content out of it lol

incentives:
$100 — i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 — chat picks my hair dye color and i dye it ON STREAM
$400 — one hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping
$600 — i vlog a grocery pickup arranged by the pantry (they buy the food with the donations)

first half of the stream is community lobbies, anyone can join and i’ll drop the code. second half, chat votes on a game every 2 hours. no repeat maps, larry.

no card? you can still help a ton: show up, join the lobbies, share the link or tell a friend so more people know it’s happening. you can also drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry’s side door on Saturdays from 9am–1pm.

hope to see you there 💚
